name: World Audio Test (dev)
author: Hails
description: Dev only (PR #32), off by default: enable it in the mod menu, or run with SKATE3_MODS_ENABLE=dev-world-audio-test. Publishes traffic, pedestrians and a ghost NPC skater around the spot where it is enabled, through sdk.world_audio, so the retail world audio can be heard before the engine has a living world. Cars loop on four lanes (C00-C08 engine records) with honks and skids; F8 fires the parked car's alarm. Peds walk, jog and run, and react to you (warn, cheer, slam); the nearest ped zaps its tazer (F7), is knocked down (F6, a retail knock-down's fall sounds), takes a phone call (F5) or turns photographer (F4). The ghost replays one of your recorded audio state logs and speaks: it saw your trick (F3), or switches between its AI voice and a pro's and crashes (F2, the main-cast channel) (logs/<name>.tsv in this folder, or SKATE_AUDIO_STATE_LOGS). F9 re-centres everything on you. Boxes show who is audible (green) or not (grey).

cars.label: Cars
cars.description: Sixteen cars on four lanes (one parked, for the alarm).

peds.label: Pedestrians
peds.description: Twenty pedestrians walking, jogging and running on lines.

own_slots.label: Own instances
own_slots.description: Cars and peds on their own MixMap instances (the mod default since world audio 4) instead of retail's pools: all within reach are heard, up to 16 + 16. Off (this test's default) shows retail's limits.

ghost.label: Ghost skater
ghost.description: A ghost NPC skater replaying a recorded audio state log.

ghost_log.label: Ghost log
ghost_log.description: The state log's name without .tsv (logs/<name>.tsv here, or in SKATE_AUDIO_STATE_LOGS).

ghost_from.label: Ghost window start (s)
ghost_from.description: Where in the log the ghost's 20 s loop starts.

boxes.label: Boxes
boxes.description: Debug boxes: green = holds an audio instance (audible), grey = not.

speed_scale.label: Traffic speed
speed_scale.description: Scales the cars' 8-15 m/s cruising speeds.
